item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 08/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southerly airstream is expected to bring hot weather and a few showers to the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. A trough of low pressure will edge closer to the coastal areas of southern China tomorrow, and bring showers and thunderstorms to the region during the weekend. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather will improve over southern China early next week. Temperatures will fall slightly.

Date/Month: 08/05 (Thursday)
Wind: East to southeast force 4 to 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Showers will be heavier with thunderstorms in some areas in the morning. Sunny intervals during the day.
Temp range: 25 - 30 C
R.H. range: 65 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
